description:
PostgreSQL instance monitoring dashboard.

Drill down from the Cluster Overview to investigate a specific instance.

Sections:
- Health: At-a-glance status
- Problems: Issues needing attention
- Settings: PostgreSQL configuration parameters

panels.description: Whether PostgreSQL is up and accepting connections.
panels.title: PostgreSQL status

panels.description: Time since PostgreSQL server started.
panels.title: Uptime

panels.description: Whether this node is a replica (1) or primary (0).
panels.title: Node role

panels.description: Percentage of max_connections in use. Above 80% is warning, above 95% is critical.

targets.expr:
sum by (job,cluster,instance) (
  sum by (job,cluster,instance) (pg_stat_activity_count{job=~"$job",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})
/
max by (job,cluster,instance) (pg_settings_max_connections{job=~"$job",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})

)

panels.title: Connection utilization

panels.description: Percentage of reads served from shared_buffers cache. Should be >95%.

targets.expr:
sum by (job,cluster,instance) (
  sum by (job,cluster,instance) (pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job=~"$job",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})
/
(
  sum by (job,cluster,instance) (pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job=~"$job",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})
  +
  sum by (job,cluster,instance) (pg_stat_database_blks_read{job=~"$job",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})
)

)

panels.title: Cache hit ratio

panels.description: Total deadlocks detected. Any deadlocks indicate contention problems.

panels.description: Queries running longer than 5 minutes. Check pg_stat_activity for details.
panels.title: Long-running queries

panels.description: Queries waiting for locks. Indicates lock contention.
panels.title: Blocked queries

panels.description: Connections idle in transaction. Can hold locks and block others.
panels.title: Idle in transaction

panels.description: WAL archive failures. Non-zero indicates backup problems!
panels.title: WAL archive failures

panels.description: Buffer flush bottlenecks per second. When bgwriter hits its limit, backends must flush buffers themselves, causing latency spikes. Should be 0.
panels.title: I/O pressure

panels.description: Lock utilization as percentage of max_locks_per_transaction * max_connections.

targets.expr:
sum by (job,cluster,instance) (
  sum by (job,cluster,instance) (pg_locks_count{job=~"$job",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})
/
(
  max by (job,cluster,instance) (pg_settings_max_locks_per_transaction{job=~"$job",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})
  *
  max by (job,cluster,instance) (pg_settings_max_connections{job=~"$job",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})
)

)

panels.title: Lock utilization

panels.description: Inactive replication slots. Can cause WAL to accumulate and fill disk!

targets.expr:
sum by (job,cluster,instance) (
  count by (job,cluster,instance) (pg_stat_replication_pg_wal_lsn_diff{job=~"$job",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance", state!="streaming"})
or
(0 * group by (job,cluster,instance) (pg_stat_replication_pg_wal_lsn_diff{job=~"$job",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}))

)

panels.title: Inactive replication slots
